title: The bird on the flats
logline: March 2027. The bird at the tide line on the mudflats, one of the spring mornings. The pup, twelve, watching it and not chasing. The last page of the bird's sequence in the book; it is not the last page it appears on.

panels.composition: The mudflats at dawn, luminous, a sunbreak on wet mud. The tide line close. On it: the rainbow bird, walking, unhurried. Ten feet off, sitting, gray at the muzzle: the three-legged dog, twelve, watching it, not moving. Two small animals and a great deal of light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, mudflats at dawn with a luminous sunbreak on wet mud, a small rainbow-colored bird walking along the tide line and an old gray-muzzled three-legged dog sitting a short distance away watching it without moving, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: The pup and the bird. Watching, not chasing. Spring.
